notes: Set newContext({ testIdAttribute }) per context, fixed at creation, instead of one global, mutable setting. Locators keep the attribute of the context they were made in; relative locators take the one of the locator they filter. Default data-testid; an invalid attribute name fails with InvalidInput.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: The attribute `getByTestId` matches is a context's setting, fixed when the context is created, so sibling contexts never share it.
